justification: Inspected extras/src/main/java/com/google/gson/graph/GraphAdapterBuilder.java and extras/src/test/java/com/google/gson/graph/GraphAdapterBuilderTest.java, plus a repo-wide rg search for "GraphAdapterBuilder"/"com.google.gson.graph". Fan-in is very low: the only concrete repository use is the dedicated test class, and no other production class references it. The class does have several outgoing dependencies (Gson, GsonBuilder, InstanceCreator, TypeAdapter/Factory, ConstructorConstructor, TypeToken, JsonReader/Writer/Token, and collections), but this is an isolated optional builder in extras rather than a dependency hub with broad incoming and outgoing coupling.
